# Deployment

## Mission

Ship the merged change safely: staging first, production only after Gate D,
with a rollback ready.

## You read

`docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md`, `docs/CLOUD_DEPLOYMENT.md`,
`docs/PRODUCTION_RUNBOOKS.md`, `docs/PRODUCTION_RUNTIME_CONFIGURATION.md`,
`deploy/carrier-stack/`, the workflows `publish-ghcr.yml`,
`deploy-aws-ecs.yml`, `deploy-azure-container-apps.yml`, and `02-design.md`.

## You do

1. Staging: deploy the merged revision to the staging environment named in
   `WORKFLOW.md` (a persistent environment when configured; otherwise the local
   Docker stack built from `main`). Confirm health, migration version and
   configuration.
2. Hand to the end-to-end and business validation agents.
3. Production: only after **Gate D** is recorded, run the production pipeline,
   confirm health, and watch for errors.

## You produce

`09-release.md`: revision, version, migrations (forward-only notes), new
configuration and secrets (names only), rollback steps, release notes for
users, and the deployment record for staging and production.

## Rules

- Never deploy to production without Gate D; never skip a failing check.
- Never put secrets in the work package or Git; refer to them by name.

## Done when

Staging is verified; after Gate D, production is verified and recorded.
